description: Official IFTA fuel tax rates (USD per US gallon) by US state / Canadian province from the IFTA, Inc. quarterly tax matrix. Current quarter: 3Q2026. Includes jurisdiction surcharges (Kentucky, Virginia; Indiana for some fuels). Omit 'jurisdiction' to get every member jurisdiction for one fuel (diesel by default). Cite the returned link and source.

fuel.description: Fuel type. Default: 'all' when a jurisdiction is given, otherwise 'diesel'.

jurisdiction.description: State or province name or 2-letter code, e.g. 'Indiana', 'IN', 'Ontario', 'ON'. Omit for all jurisdictions.

quarter.description: Tax quarter, e.g. '3Q2026' or 'Q3 2026'. Default: current quarter.

name: get_ifta_rates
title: Get IFTA fuel tax rates
